summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for recurrent nausea, vomiting, and worsening diarrhea one week after discharge for C. difficile infection. She had been vomiting her oral vancomycin, raising concern for under-treatment. She was managed with IV fluids, IV anti-nausea medication, and continued oral vancomycin with improved tolerance. Her symptoms resolved, she advanced to a regular diet, and her bowel movements became formed. Chronic abdominal pain was managed with non-opioid medications due to concerns about motility. She was discharged home with instructions to complete her vancomycin course and follow up with GI and pain management. Asymptomatic bacteriuria was noted but not treated.
